user.title: Connect a Pubky Music node
user.description: The node's address and port (as in its web UI) and its API token (Settings › Node, or `[api] token` in node.toml).

zeroconf_confirm.title: Pubky Music node found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name} at {host}? Enter its API token (Settings › Node, or `[api] token` in node.toml).

zeroconf_moved.title: Pubky Music node at a new address?
zeroconf_moved.description: {name} is set up at {old}, and a node with its id now answers at {new}. Anyone on your network can claim a node's id, so the API token goes to {new} only if you say so. Use the new address if you moved the node or its address changed; otherwise ignore this.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The node refused the token. Enter its current API token.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the node at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The node refused the API token.
error.not_this_node: The node at the new address is a different node.

abort.already_configured: This node is already set up.
abort.not_a_node: That is a Pubky Music endpoint, not a node.
abort.moved: The node's new address is saved.
